goal: Prevent worker-owned R/J/O integration requests from demanding canonical Reality while their referenced CAP-0003 projection explicitly marks the requested facts dimension-incomplete, and surface the semantic distinction between fact completeness and cross-entity comparability before integration execution.
baseline_impact: none; this reuses CAP-0003 reconciliation, CAP-0007 fail-closed orchestration, CAP-0009 continuity and CAP-0010 workstream routing without changing any Reality/Judgment/Outcome/Evidence/PIT semantic expectation
baseline_invariants: dimensions_complete=false remains a CAP-0003 declaration that the FactAssertion itself lacks required dimensions and therefore must fail closed before canonical Reality

cross-entity or cross-issuer non-comparability remains separate from fact completeness and continues to be expressed through truthful dimensions/statistical scope plus downstream comparability and Outcome relation semantics
Grounded Evidence identity, locator, provenance and temporal rules remain unchanged
Reality, contemporaneous Judgment, later Outcome and PIT/no-lookahead remain separate and fail closed
worker branch/fence/single-writer ownership and global_serial integration authority remain unchanged
no L3/L4 Baseline, schema, semantic-owner or source-authority change is introduced
schema_impact: none; static request/projection preflight, CI wiring and regression tests only
acceptance: An open typed integration request with execution_contract.reality_fact_keys and exactly one CAP-0003 Reality projection input fails preflight if any requested target fact resolves to dimensions_complete=false.
The failure explains that dimensions_complete describes the fact's own dimension completeness and must not be used merely as a proxy for cross-entity non-comparability.

A narrow issuer/entity-specific Reality fact that is truthful and complete inside its declared statistical_scope/scope_guard can pass with dimensions_complete=true while downstream comparability remains independently fail-closed.
Missing requested Reality fact keys fail preflight rather than reaching integration execution.
Closed requests and unrelated requests without reality_fact_keys are not newly blocked.
The worker-fast exact-head gate runs the preflight before remote CLEAN continuity is accepted, and focused regression tests cover failure, success, missing-key and non-target cases.
No reconciler behavior, Judgment completeness rule, Outcome relation behavior, Evidence standard or PIT rule changes.
